channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Your Guide To ‘Alternative’ Holiday Movie Screenings In Chicago This Season
item.description: Go beyond Bedford Falls with the Muppets, festive romances, madcap adventures and a heartwarming anime classic at big screens across the city.

item.title: Maternity Care Is Lacking On The South Side. Kennedy-King’s Midwife Program Aims To Change That
item.description: Students in the program will train in a state-of-the-art simulation classroom and earn national certification and state licensure.

item.title: Garfield Park’s BlkRoom Brings Coworking For Black Creatives To The West Side
item.description: Part coworking space, part maker studio, the BlkRoom gives members affordable access to studios and other amenities while fostering opportunities for local artists.

item.title: SOL Collective Brings Healing Stories From Women Of Color To New Collaboraction Theatre
item.description: With 8 performers and 7 stories, much of the show is about holiday gatherings with friends and family and the complexities those bring, the show’s leader said.

item.title: Fulton Market Apartment High-Rise And New Public Plaza Approved By City Council
item.description: The building will house nearly 400 apartments and will also include a new Divvy station funded by the developer.

item.title: Rogers Park’s Leona’s, Uptown School Parking Lot To Become Apartments After City Council Vote
item.description: The projects will bring a combined 158 apartments to the Far North Side while bringing new life to underutilized properties in the area.

item.title: With Morgan Commons Approval, Long-Vacant South Side ‘Eyesore’ To Become Housing, Retail
item.description: City Council approved rezoning of the nearly 13-acre site, which will include transit-oriented affordable housing, retail space, a performance arts center and a new 2-acre park.

item.title: 50 Apartments Coming To Logan Square’s Vacant Lot Near ‘Greetings From Chicago’ Mural
item.description: Ald. Daniel La Spata and the development team have assured the community the mural will not be blocked, and updated renderings show parking space between the new development and the art wall so people can still stop by for pictures.

item.title: DePaul Cleared To Build New Athletic Complex In Lincoln Park, Replacing Century-Old Homes
item.description: The facility, which will replace four 1890s rowhouses and a student apartment building, was redesigned multiple times to address preservation concerns and neighborhood feedback.

item.title: Alders, Mayor Johnson Tweak Budget Proposals — But Shutdown Looms As Impasse Continues
item.description: A group of 27 alderpeople introduced a set of alternative budget proposals to City Council Wednesday that would scrap a corporate head tax. Mayor Brandon Johnson has doubled down on his support of the idea.
